title: VPN Connection Timeout
problem: Users experience timeout errors when attempting to connect to the corporate VPN from remote locations
resolution: 1. Verify internet connection stability. 2. Check firewall settings and ensure VPN ports (UDP 500 and 4500) are open. 3. Restart VPN client application. 4. Clear VPN cache in application settings. 5. If issue persists restart the VPN service on the server. 6. Contact network team if problem continues.
notes: Common issue during peak hours especially for users on home networks. May be related to ISP throttling.

title: Outlook Keeps Crashing
problem: Outlook closes by itself a few seconds after it opens
resolution: 1. Start Outlook in safe mode with outlook.exe /safe to see whether an add-in is the cause. 2. If it starts, open File, Options, Add-ins, and turn the COM add-ins off one at a time. 3. Restart Outlook normally after each one, until the add-in that crashes it is found. 4. If safe mode crashes too, close Outlook and run the Microsoft Support and Recovery Assistant. 5. Repair Office from Settings, Apps, Microsoft 365, Modify, choosing Quick Repair first. 6. If Quick Repair doesn't help, run Online Repair, which downloads Office again and takes longer. 7. Create a new Outlook profile from Control Panel, Mail, Show Profiles, and set it as the default. 8. Rebuild the search index from Indexing Options if Outlook crashes while searching. 9. Check the size of the OST file in AppData, Local, Microsoft, Outlook: over 50 GB slows it down. 10. Turn on Cached Exchange Mode with a shorter time to keep offline, such as one year. 11. Update the graphics driver, since Outlook draws its window with hardware acceleration. 12. Turn off hardware graphics acceleration in File, Options, Advanced, Display, if it still crashes. 13. Collect the crash details from Event Viewer, Windows Logs, Application, source Application Error. 14. Send the faulting module's name to the messaging team with the user's Office version and build.
notes: Usually after a monthly Office update.

title: Printer Offline After Move
problem: The printer shows as offline after the office move
resolution: 1. Re-add the printer with its new IP address.

title: Phone Enrolment Fails
problem: A phone can't enrol in device management
resolution: 1. Open the Company Portal app on the phone and sign in again with the work account and its password. 2. Remove the old device from the portal's device list so that a second copy of it doesn't block enrolment. 3. Reinstall the Company Portal app from the store and enrol the phone again from the start screen. 4. Accept every permission the app asks for including the device administrator. 5. Wait.
